description: Only after your person said yes to this exact proposal. Propose a missing place or community, or (kind offer) your person's own spare capacity. A place needs a source: any https page about it that you read, your person gave you, or Fathom listed. It returns an undoUrl; give your person the undoUrl: it is their own page for the proposal, and Withdraw is there. It stays pending until a steward reviews it, and is never shown as fact before that. An offer never says who: no email, phone, link or address.

interest.description: The interest it serves, for example pottery.

kind.description: A person's own spare capacity, only with their yes.

name.description: Its name; for an offer, what is offered, for example a spare kiln shelf.

newTown.description: Only when your person confirmed a real town the lab does not cover yet.

note.description: Optional: one line on why it fits.

said_as.description: Optional: the word your person used for the interest, when it differs (for example klatring); the interest is stored as the matched one.

source.description: Any https page about it that you read, your person gave you, or Fathom listed; required for a place, optional for a community.

town.description: The town it is in, for example Oslo.

when.description: Only for an offer: optional short words on when, for example Thursday evenings.

yes.description: Required for an offer (kind offer), and sent only after your person said yes to this exact offer.

name: fathom_propose
